security.root_confinement: When KORDOC_ROOT is configured, resolved input and output paths must remain within that root; offline mode applies its configured access root.
security.input_resolution: Resolve input paths with realpath before checking the extension allowlist and reading the file; reject missing paths and paths outside the configured root.
security.output_resolution: Check the output extension allowlist; reject a symlink at the final path; resolve the nearest existing ancestor and remaining path within the root; recheck the real parent after processing and open the leaf with O_NOFOLLOW.
security.no_input_overwrite: redact_document explicitly rejects an output resolving to the same file as the input. Other output-producing tools write the caller-supplied output_path; the source has no shared same-file rejection rule for them.
security.sanitized_errors: Error responses use text content with isError=true. Native exceptions are classified and sanitized; filesystem errors use code-specific hints. Explicit KordocError validation messages may include the offending path or extension, as in the source behavior.
security.stdout_logging: Console output is routed to stderr before server startup; stdout is reserved for JSON-RPC framing.
security.import_behavior: Importing src/mcp.ts from another entry point does not auto-start stdio; direct execution auto-starts, and startMcpServer is idempotent.

file_path.description: Absolute document path; HWP, HWPX, PDF, XLSX, DOCX, PNG, JPG, or WebP.

ocr.description: OCR scanned or image PDF pages; true handles pages without usable text, force re-recognizes every page.

remove_header_footer.description: Remove repeating PDF headers and footers; source default is true.

formula_ocr.description: Enable PDF formula OCR; model weights may be downloaded on first use.

dedupe_running_headers.description: Remove repeated running headers in HWP5 layout tables; default off.

keep_trailing_empty_cols.description: Preserve trailing empty table columns; default off.

keep_empty_paragraphs.description: Preserve empty body paragraphs and table-cell lines; default off.

include_field_placeholders.description: Include unfilled HWP field placeholder instructions; default off.

html_tables.description: Render all tables as indented HTML tables; default off.

script_tags.description: Emit superscript and subscript markup; parser format defaults vary, false emits plain text.

plain.description: Emit plain Markdown without image placeholders, link URLs, underline, or bold markup; default off.

password.description: Password for supported encrypted HWPX, HWP3, or HWP5 files; does not bypass DRM.

tables.description: Enable PDF table detection; source default is true.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to identify.
Absolute path of the document whose metadata is extracted.

file_path_a.description: Absolute path of the source document.

file_path_b.description: Absolute path of the comparison document.

granularity.description: Merge adjacent text by breadcrumb section or emit one IR block per chunk.

include_table_cells.description: Include each table chunk's two-dimensional cell text array.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the form document.
Absolute path of the form template; omit when using a built-in template.

template.description: Built-in standard Korean government form; use instead of file_path.

fields.description: Map form labels to values to fill.

formats.description: Optional label-to-format map for date, phone, RRN, masking, or custom patterns.

require_unique.description: Reject ambiguous labels that match multiple fields; default false.

mask_values.description: Hide filled values in the response and show lengths only.

output_format.description: Choose Markdown, generated HWPX, or HWPX preserving the source style.

output_path.description: Optional output path; when omitted the result is returned as text.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the target HWPX document.

image_path.description: Absolute path of a seal or signature image; transparent PNG is recommended.

anchor.description: Anchor text above which the seal is placed.

occurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence when the anchor appears more than once.

size_mm.description: Seal side length in millimeters; default is line height times 1.6, clamped to 7–18 mm.

mode.description: Place over the anchor, to its right, or automatically to the right when space permits.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source HWPX or HWP 5.x document.

edited_markdown.description: Complete edited Markdown from parse_document; preserve block count and order.

output_path.description: Absolute output path with the same .hwpx or .hwp extension as the source.

file_path.description: Absolute path of the document to inspect and redact.

rules.description: Detection rules; defaults cover rrn, phone, email, card, account, brn, passport, driver. crn, ip, name, and address are opt-in.

output_path.description: Output path; HWPX/HWP uses the same extension, other formats use Markdown; required unless dry_run is true.

dry_run.description: Return a detection report without creating a file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the HWPX or HWP 5.x document to render.

format.description: png/jpeg return images; svg/html/pdf require output_path.

output_path.description: Optional destination whose extension matches format; required for svg, html, and pdf.

highlights.description: Search terms to highlight in the rendered pages.

reflow_mode.description: Reflow by word or by individual character.

pages.description: Optional 1-based page selection; image responses include at most 8 pages.

max_width_px.description: Maximum raster image width in pixels.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the HWPX or HWP 5.x document.

output_dir.description: Directory where crop images and regions.json are written.

padding_pt.description: Padding around the bounding box in points.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the HWPX or HWP 5.x document.

output_dir.description: Directory for crop images and tables.json; required when visual is not none.

visual.description: Select which table regions to crop while returning classification and bounds.

cells.description: Include cell text grids in response JSON.

hwpx_path.description: Absolute path to the reference HWPX document.

markdown.description: Complete Markdown source to convert to HWPX; tables use GitHub Flavored Markdown.

output_path.description: Absolute path for the generated HWPX file.

profile_path.description: Optional JSON format profile previously extracted with extract_profile.

preset.description: Optional government document style preset or alias; omit for general Markdown conversion.

font.description: Body font override (myeongjo or gothic); defaults to myeongjo when omitted.

body_pt.description: Body font size in points; preset defaults: official 12, report 15, plan 15, notice 15, minutes 14, gaejosik 15, press 14, ministry 15, bangchim 15.

line_spacing.description: Body line spacing percentage; preset defaults: official 160, report 160, plan 160, notice 160, minutes 130, gaejosik 160, press 160, ministry 145, bangchim 190.

org.description: Organization name for cover or official header.

date.description: Cover date in YYYY. M. D. format; when omitted, rendering uses today's date.

toc.description: Build a table of contents from h2 headings. Press preset suppresses the table of contents; by default it is enabled only for gaejosik and ministry presets.

cover.description: Generate a cover from the first h1. By default it is enabled for gaejosik and ministry, disabled for press, and disabled for other presets; supplying org, date, dept, or cover_label automatically enables it unless cover is explicitly false.

approval.description: Approval role labels; at most six. Empty or omitted approval creates no approval table.

page_numbers.description: Add page numbers excluding cover and table-of-contents pages. By default enabled for gaejosik, ministry, report, plan, and bangchim presets.

end_mark.description: Add the administrative closing mark 끝.; defaults on only for official, and off for all other presets.

body_title_box.description: Repeat the title in a box on the first body page; defaults on only for gaejosik when a cover is enabled.

chapter_fit.description: Fit chapter heading width to its title; default false.

h2_marker.description: Chapter heading marker; defaults to band for report/plan, square for bangchim, number for notice, and none for other presets.

band_color.description: Six-digit hexadecimal chapter-band fill color; defaults to #003366.

band_text_color.description: Six-digit hexadecimal chapter-band text color; defaults to #FFFFFF.

summary.description: Optional summary text for a report summary box.

checklist.description: Optional Seoul review checklist: a boolean or an object with not-applicable item numbers and notes.

cover_label.description: Cover handling label such as 대외주의 or 비공개.

fonts.description: Per-role font overrides for body, heading, ref, and table. Report-family presets (gaejosik, report, plan, bangchim) apply all four roles; other presets apply body only.

sizes.description: Per-element point-size overrides; supported by report-family presets (gaejosik, report, plan, bangchim).

levels.description: Optional typography overrides by list depth 0 through 7.

bullet2.description: Second-level bullet; defaults to ○ for gaejosik and ㅇ for other presets.

suppress_single.description: Suppress a single sibling marker in standard numbering styles; default false.

doc_foot.description: Optional official document footer and contact fields.

report_info.description: Optional responsible staff and contact row.

notice_head.description: Optional notice number, date, and sender.

press.description: Optional press release timing, subtitles, and contact details.

landscape.description: Use landscape orientation; defaults to portrait.

columns.description: Number of text columns; defaults to one.

header.description: Header text on each page; inline Markdown is allowed.

image_dir.description: Directory from which referenced PNG, JPEG, GIF, or BMP images are embedded.

content.text: formatted metadata, outline, warnings, and Markdown

parse_document.response_behavior: One text item, truncated with an explicit marker at 200000 JavaScript characters.

detect_format.response_behavior: One text item; no response-character cap.

parse_metadata.response_behavior: One text item; input file limit is 50 MiB; no response-character cap.

parse_pages.response_behavior: One text item for selected pages; no response-character cap.

parse_table.response_behavior: One text item; no response-character cap.

content.text: text diff summary and changed blocks

compare_documents.response_behavior: One text item; each displayed changed text is clipped to 200 characters; no global response cap.

parse_chunks.response_behavior: One text item, truncated with marker at 200000 JavaScript characters.

parse_form.response_behavior: One text item; no response-character cap.

content.text: filled form preview or saved-file summary

fill_form.response_behavior: Text content. mask_values hides filled values; Markdown may be returned as preview, HWPX output is written only to output_path.

content.text: saved output path and placement summary

place_seal.response_behavior: One text item; writes HWPX to output_path.

content.text: saved output path and patch verification summary

patch_document.response_behavior: One text item; writes patched HWPX/HWP to output_path.

content.text: detection counts, capped findings, and save/re-scan status

redact_document.response_behavior: One text item, globally truncated at 200000 JavaScript characters; listed findings and residuals are separately capped at 50 lines. Failed residual/unscanned checks set isError=true.

content.text: render summary and saved output path

render_document.response_behavior: Raster PNG/JPEG return up to 8 image items followed by a text summary; svg/html/pdf return one text item after writing output files. No global response-character cap.

content.text: saved crop manifest and region summaries

crop_regions.response_behavior: One text item; writes image crops and regions.json to output_dir.

extract_tables.response_behavior: For visual none, return one text item. For visual crop modes, return zero to 8 image content items followed by one final text item; zero crops therefore produce a text-only response. Crops and tables.json are written to output_dir when enabled. No global response-character cap.

content.text: saved profile path and table count

extract_profile.response_behavior: One text item; writes JSON profile to output_path.

content.text: saved HWPX path, mode, size, and warnings

generate_document.response_behavior: One text item; writes generated HWPX to output_path.

source_evidence.extraction_command: sha256sum src/mcp.ts src/mcp/tools-parse.ts src/mcp/tools-form.ts src/mcp/tools-render.ts src/mcp/tools-generate.ts src/mcp/shared.ts src/shared/offline.ts src/utils.ts src/hwpx/gongmun-surface.ts src/hwpx/gongmun.ts src/shared/generate-images.ts
source_evidence.review_command: rg -n -A24 'server\.tool\(' src/mcp/tools-{parse,form,render,generate}.ts; rg -n 'MAX_FILE_SIZE|MAX_METADATA_FILE_SIZE|MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS|safePath|safeOutputPath|writeOutputFile|PARSE_EXTENSIONS|IMAGE_EXTENSIONS|PROFILE_EXTENSIONS' src/mcp/shared.ts; sed -n '15,55p' src/hwpx/gongmun-surface.ts; sed -n '272,289p' src/hwpx/gongmun.ts; sed -n '1,60p' src/mcp.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/shared/offline.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/utils.ts; sed -n '1,150p' src/shared/generate-images.ts

generation_behavior.date: If omitted, the renderer uses today's date for a cover.
generation_behavior.explicit_overrides: toc, cover, page_numbers, end_mark, body_title_box, chapter_fit, marker, color and typography options override preset defaults where supported; cover false has priority over org/date/dept/cover_label auto-enable. The press preset always suppresses covers and TOCs.
generation_behavior.cover_date_default: Today at render time when no date is provided.

fill_form.without_output_path: Return text preview; with output_path save selected file. mask_values suppresses field values in response.
fill_form.input_source_precedence: template wins when truthy; otherwise file_path is read; absence of both returns an error

crop_regions.output_dir_validation: regions.json is checked as a .json output beneath the configured root

extract_tables.output_dir_validation: tables.json is checked as a .json output beneath the configured root

generate_document.image_path_rules: resolve image_dir and each referenced local file; reject paths outside image_dir, check configured root, open with O_NOFOLLOW; remote URLs are not fetched
